verdict.rationale: Lever is a SaaS applicant tracking system, so choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or where customer data is hosted. The items cover webhooks, the API, career sites, automation, analytics and AI features, none of which concern storage location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
